description: Header file defining interface for virtual serial port testing in Zephyr OS, including functions for queueing, reading, peeking data, and setting callbacks.

methods.name: serial_vnd_queue_in_data
methods.description: Queues data to be read by the virtual serial port.

methods.name: serial_vnd_out_data_size_get
methods.description: Returns size of unread written data.

methods.name: serial_vnd_read_out_data
methods.description: Reads data written to virtual serial port, consuming it.

methods.name: serial_vnd_peek_out_data
methods.description: Peeks at data written to virtual serial port without consuming it.

methods.name: serial_vnd_set_callback
methods.description: Sets the callback function to be called after data is written to the port.
